_doc: Fidelity-risk ACKNOWLEDGED carve-out (item R1, landed 2026-07-18). The fidelityRisk gate (FidelityRiskGateTest) fails LOUDLY, per combo, whenever a pinned Green/Amber combo rests on a card whose gold fixture is on tests/magic-ast-tests/Fixtures/oracle-text-quarantine.json (known-drifted oracle text) -- GoldCorpus reads Output.Oracle.Abilities directly and never re-parses Input.OracleText, so a drifted fixture silently props up whatever tier its combos certify at. This whitelist is the SAME shrink-only-ratchet pattern as oracle-text-quarantine.json itself: an entry here says 'yes, this pin currently rests on already-tracked quarantine debt, and that is KNOWN and accepted for now' -- NOT that the pin is correct. An acknowledged combo whose FidelityRisk becomes empty (its quarantined card was fixed/de-quarantined) FAILS until removed -- the list only shrinks. Seeded in one shot by mechanically joining combo-expected-tiers.json against oracle-text-quarantine.json (Input.Name -> fixturePath join) the moment the gate landed, so it captures debt that PRE-DATES the gate, not something the gate's author reviewed card-by-card -- per the governing principle, growth of this list may be sweep-PROPOSED, but each entry here is a human-confirmed acceptance once reviewed, so treat this seed as a PROPOSAL pending that review, not a settled decision.
